    AI Overview
    Power is a acclaimed Starz crime drama that premiered in June 2014 and concluded its 6-season, 63-episode run on February 9, 2020. The series follows James "Ghost" St. Patrick, a nightclub owner leading a double life as a drug kingpin. The franchise includes spin-offs Book II: Ghost, Book III: Raising Kanan, and Book IV: Force. 
    Key Details About Power (TV Series) 
    • Premise: James "Ghost" St. Patrick seeks to leave the drug world to pursue legitimate business, dealing with family, betrayal, and high-stakes drama.
    • Seasons: 6 seasons (2014–2020).
    • Episodes:
      63 episodes.
    • Finale: The show concluded on February 9, 2020, following a sixth and final season.
    • Spin-offs: The Power universe has expanded to include several spin-offs:
      • Power Book II: Ghost
      • Power Book III: Raising Kanan
      • Power Book IV: Force 
    The original series and its expansions have been recognized as some of Starz's highest-rated content.

    Is there a season 7 of power?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    No, there will not be a season 7 of the original Power series. The show concluded after its sixth season, which aired in 2019–2020. However, the "Power Universe" continues through several spin-offs, including Power Book II: Ghost, Power Book III: Raising Kanan, and Power Book IV: Force, with Power: Origins in development. 
    • Original Series: Power ended with season 6, as confirmed by 50 Cent and Starz.
    • Spin-offs: The universe expanded with multiple sequels, though some, like Force (ending after season 3 in 2025) and Ghost, are concluding, while others continue.
    • Future: Power: Origins is planned to focus on the early lives of Ghost and Tommy. 
    Force season 3 is the final season of that specific spin-off, airing in late 2025

      First episode date
      June 7, 2014 (USA)
      It appears James "Ghost" St. Patrick has it all -- a drop-dead gorgeous wife, a stunning Manhattan penthouse, and the power and success that come with owning hot new nightclub Truth. But a closer look reveals a man living a double life. When Ghost isn't tending to his Fortune 500 business, he's catering to clients of another operation: a drug empire that serves only the rich and influential. While loyal sidekick Tommy protects the cash-cow narcotics venture at all costs, Ghost's new reality is using Truth as more than a front to launder money. It's a way out of the drug game and into a legitimate life with his family, even if everything he loves becomes unknowingly threatened. "Power" is co-executive produced by Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson (who also co-stars) and show creator Courtney Kemp Agboh ("The Good Wife"). MoreLessDescription
